simple.summary: בָּתַר (bâthar) means to chop up First listed occurrence: Gen 15 10.

definitions.full: H1334. bathar [ בָּתַר ] verb cut in two (Arabic cut off prematurely; extirpate by cutting ) — Qal Perfect בָּתָ֑ר Gen 15:10 ; Pi`el Imperfect וַיְבַתֵּר Gen 15:10 id.
